# Data-quality record (generated by scripts/eda.py)

* Trips with a gap > 60 s: 23 (00000002, 00000006, 00000011, 00000014, 00000021, 00000024, 00000028, 00000041, 00000042, 00000043, 00000044, 00000054, 00000055, 00000069, 00000070, 00000078, 00000081, 00000084, 00000085, 00000088, 00000089, 00000090, 00000065). Largest gap 153064 s (trip 00000090).
* Share of 1 s steps: median 99.1%, min 53.1%.
* No NaNs or malformed rows (see eda_missing.csv); timestamps strictly increasing in every trip: True.
* Reference routes not fully contiguous (consecutive arcs not sharing a node): 11 trips, worst 0.981.
* Routes that revisit an arc (loops / U-turns): 10 trips.
* Isolated nodes in networks: total 0. Networks are clipped extracts, so many weak components exist at the clip boundary (median 19).
* Highest p95 GPS-to-road distance: 00000054 (101 m), 00000002 (67 m), 00000081 (38 m), 00000084 (35 m), 00000033 (31 m)

## Decisions
* Trips 00000033 and 00000054 (train): the GPS track is 130-200 m from its own reference route for most of the trip while staying inside the same bounding box, i.e. the reference does not describe the recording. They are excluded from fitting/CV (78 training trips remain).
* Fixes more than 60 m from their aligned reference arc are flagged unreliable and excluded from training rows (10.7 % of train fixes, 90 % of them from the two trips above; 1.2 % of the remaining 78 trips; 0.13 % of student-test fixes).
* Candidate set: 12 nearest directed arcs within 80 m. Reference arc missing from the set: 8.2 % of all train fixes, 0.81 % on the 78 usable trips, 0.21 % on their reliable fixes, 0.18 % on student-test (candidate_sweep.csv has the K x radius trade-off).
* Distances use a per-trip azimuthal-equidistant projection centred on the track.
* Chains are broken at gaps > gap_s (decoder parameter) and bridged by shortest path.
